evidence.title: Margin Notes / Evidence case
evidence.question: Which explanation fits all three signed records?
clues: The outage log records failure at 03:12.
The insurer approved a denial at 02:50 using the same event number.
A vendor receipt binds both records to a token issued the previous evening.

answers.title: The records disagree because of an ordinary clerical error.
answers.feedback: A clerical error does not explain the matching signed authorizations and their order.

answers.title: A lone outsider forged every record after the event.
answers.feedback: The independent receipt and earlier signatures rule out a single later forgery.

answers.title: The outage and its denial were planned together.
answers.feedback: Compensation was denied before the emergencies occurred.
